attchmntText: GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GVK Power and Infrastructure Limited filed un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. Standalone results show a loss after tax of 103,893 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated results show a loss after tax of 137,856 lakhs for the half year. Standalone basic earnings per share is negative 0.00 rupees. Consolidated basic earnings per share is negative 0.01 rupees. Paid-up equity share capital remains 15,792 lakhs. The Board Meeting concluded on 13th November 2026. The results include a limited review report from the statutory auditors.
